name: tavall-ai-plugin
description: Portable Tavall AI entry point: Tavall agents, the Tavall skill orchestrator, and discovery of the authenticated Tavall MCP/Console capability surface.

interface.shortDescription: Tavall agents, orchestration, and MCP/Console discovery
interface.longDescription: Use one portable Tavall AI plugin across AI clients. The bundled orchestrator discovers the live Tavall MCP/Function Catalog surface, bootstraps or resumes the current Tavall development session, routes work to the bundled Tavall agent roles, and executes ordinary engineering commands through Tavall Console instead of inventing client-specific workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use tavall-skill-orchestrator as the normal entry point for Tavall work
Discover the live Tavall MCP and Function Catalog surface before assuming capabilities
Bootstrap or resume the current Tavall development session before creating new environments, lanes, or workspaces
Route substantive work to the smallest useful set of bundled Tavall agent roles
Prefer Tavall Console with normal tavall, git, gh, build, and shell commands over bespoke MCP wrappers
Use tavall-agent-scheduler only when placement, isolation, resource pressure, recovery, or safely independent parallel work requires another worker/session
Validate diff-producing work against the exact final HEAD using repository-owned validation through the authorized Tavall execution surface
